raw_comment: I noticed that there was multiple cases of droughts in places that are not hot and dry, such as Oregon, New York and other states on the eastern half of the Mississippi River. I wonder how these areas get into drought when they are surrounded by so much water, especially since they have a large amount of coastline and reservoirs. This relates to me personally and my community since we are so reliant on water, as we require it not only for drinking but to also grow crops for food as well, and without it we would have to go hungry. A potential headline for this graph could be: "The spread and impact of droughts across the United States."
